rationale: The candidate reads coherently across views as one compact bar with a modest roof articulation, so gesture and repair integrity are decent. However, it is essentially a sealed rectangular extrusion with only a weak roof kink and no convincing public void, court, notch, or active ground threshold. The verified access edge is not meaningfully opened; the road-facing response is semantically underdeveloped for neighborhood living. As a result, the mass is plausible as a generic building object but not yet as a neighborhood program with an active street edge and one clear public space figure. It also leans more toward a generic bar/pavilion than a program-specific mixed neighborhood massing. The two references suggest either connected terraced civic fragments or a restrained pavilion with an entry recess; the candidate does not yet achieve either.
